
---

### Installing

Open the DMG and drag **Corral** to Applications.

Builds are signed ad hoc, not notarised, so the first launch needs
**right-click → Open** (or **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open
Anyway**). Verify what you downloaded against the checksum above, and
`Corral --version` prints the commit it was built from.

### What it needs

Nothing. No Full Disk Access, no accessibility, no entitlements — every fact
Corral shows is already readable by any process running as you, and it has no
network code at all.
